title: Break a large job into checkable steps
summary: A large task can be split into smaller outputs that a person can review. Each step should have a clear product.
introduction: A large task can be split into smaller outputs that a person can review. Each step should have a clear product. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain break a large job into checkable steps
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A large task can be split into smaller outputs that a person can review. Each step should have a clear product.

blocks.code:
Goal: make a short lesson on recycling
Step 1: list three learning points
Step 2: check their facts
Step 3: write a simple example for each
Step 4: make two practice questions
blocks.title: Break a large job into checkable steps

blocks.text: The steps give the reviewer a chance to correct the learning points before a whole lesson is written. They request useful work products, not hidden internal reasoning.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a final check for difficult words.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: More steps do not help if they repeat the same unclear task.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
